To the entire team at CampusHunger The Daily Tiffin Service,

I would be absolutely thrilled if you could introduce special thalis such as Prawn Thali, Bombil Thali, Pomfret Thali, and Mutton Thali. I am also always eager to try any other regional fish recipes you might feature.

Finally, I want to applaud you for maintaining such high quality while keeping your prices affordable. This balance is invaluable for students and professionals alike.

Thank you for the great work. Please keep serving the good food!

Best regards,
Aniket Kundu
